title: Various spectra and energies of subgroup generating bipartite graph
summary: Let $L(G)$ be the set of all subgroups of a group $G$. The subgroup generating bipartite graph $\mathcal{B}(G)$ defined on $G$ is a bipartite graph whose vertex set is partitioned into two sets $G \times G$ and $L(G)$, and two vertices $(a, b) \in G \times G$ and $H \in L(G)$ are adjacent if $H$ is generated by $a$ and $b$. In this paper, we compute various spectra and energies of $\mathcal{B}(G)$ and determine whether $\mathcal{B}(G)$ is hypoenergetic, hyperenergetic, CN-hyperenergetic, L-hyperenergetic or Q-hyperenergetic if $G$ is a dihedral group of order $2p$ and $2p^2$ and dicyclic…
